title.narrative: Providing safe drinking water in the Republic of Chad

description.narrative: 123,000 people obtained safe drinking water in 3 Chadian regions, increasing the level of access to clean water in the beneficiary regions, quenching the thirst of Chadian people and preserving their dignity, reducing the spread of diseases resulting from drinking contaminated water, and providing job opportunities for at least about 30 people through activities The project contributes to alleviating unemployment.

Contributing to the provision of potable water by providing permanent and renewable water sources, by drilling 82 artesian wells in three Chadian regions where it is difficult to obtain clean water. The project covers about 27% of the need in the targeted regions, and 100% of the number of beneficiaries in the project, noting that The project is not limited to providing water to people only, but also extends its benefit to livestock and its use in irrigating farms in some areas.
Improving the quality of life by providing safe and clean water to the most needy communities in the Republic of Chad
